item.title: Cargo-Lite 2.0 released: shared build cache brings 41-minute compiles down to six
item.description: Rust build tool Cargo-Lite released version 2.0 with a shared, content-addressed build cache. A large monorepo team reported clean builds dropping from 41 minutes to 6. The configuration format changes in 3.0 and a migration command is provided. Reviewers note the cache works with any S3-compatible bucket.

item.title: Python 3.14 is out: free-threaded builds become the Linux default
item.description: Python 3.14 shipped with the free-threaded build enabled by default on Linux. Early benchmarks show single-thread regressions of two to five percent and large gains for CPU-bound threaded code. Several popular extensions still need updates, and the release notes list them.

item.title: Study: LLM judges prefer longer answers regardless of correctness
item.description: An open evaluation suite compared judge models against human labels on 2,000 answer pairs. Judges preferred the longer answer 68 percent of the time when the two answers were equally correct, and 41 percent of the time when the longer answer was wrong. Swapping the order changed the verdict in 12 percent of cases. The authors recommend explicit length instructions and order randomization.

item.title: SQLite 3.52 adds native vector search
item.description: SQLite 3.52 includes a vector index type that stores float32 embeddings and answers nearest-neighbor queries with cosine or L2 distance. The developers position it for applications with up to a few million vectors that already keep their data in SQLite. Benchmarks show query times under 10 milliseconds for one million 768-dimensional vectors on a laptop.

item.title: Kubernetes 1.36 upgrade breaks pod networking on legacy CNI
item.description: Several operators reported that upgrading to Kubernetes 1.36 broke pod networking on clusters that still use the legacy CNI plugin. The 1.36 release notes list the plugin as removed, but the upgrade pre-flight check did not flag it. A workaround is to install a maintained CNI before the upgrade. The maintainers said a pre-flight warning will ship in 1.36.1.
